messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "symptoms especially reported when stopped abruptly"
set: ["symptoms especially reported when stopped abruptly", "adverse reactions likely when stopped abruptly", "withdrawal symptoms when stopped suddenly after long-term use", "withdrawal symptoms if stopped suddenly", "stopping abruptly can cause serious withdrawal symptoms", "high blood sugar when medicine is stopped", "especially NSAIDs", "especially lithium", "do not stop abruptly", "monitor for withdrawal symptoms when discontinuing therapy", "especially when an agent with greater diuretic potential is desired", "especially mineral oil", "medicine started or stopped", "after medicine is stopped", "slow or stopped breathing", "stopping abruptly can cause uncontrolled pain"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
